mapper.select: SELECT MAX(sd.price*sd.exchange_rate) AS maxPrice, MIN(sd.price*sd.exchange_rate) AS minPrice, sd.sku_id, COUNT(sd.sku_id) AS count, round( SUM (sd.amount_local_currency) / sum(sd.qty), 2 ) avgPrice FROM so_detail sd INNER JOIN so_info si ON sd.main_id = si.id AND si.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sd.is_deleted=FALSE AND si.approve_status=#{approveStatus} AND sku_id!='' and qty!=0 GROUP BY sku_id

SELECT sd.id, sd.main_id, sd.sku_id, sd.sku_no, sd.qty, sd.is_gift, sd.is_close, sd.remark, sd.delivery_status, si.approve_status FROM so_detail sd INNER JOIN so_info si ON sd.main_id = si.id AND sd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE si.is_deleted=FALSE

SELECT sd.id, sd.main_id, sd.sku_id, sd.sku_no, sd.qty, sd.price, sd.tax_rate, sd.amount, sd.all_amount_local_currency, sd.currency, sd.currency_symbol, sd.exchange_rate, sd.is_gift, sd.is_reissue, sd.is_close, sd.remark, sd.delivery_status, sd.kingdee_detail_id, sd.platform_sku_no, sd.purchase_price, sd.sale_cost, sd.sale_profit, sd.sale_profit_rate, sd.tax_amount, sd.warehouse_location, sd.amount_local_currency, sd.all_amount_local_currency, sd.discount_amount, sd.tax_amount_before, sd.exchange_rate FROM so_detail sd INNER JOIN so_info si ON sd.main_id = si.id AND sd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE si.is_deleted = FALSE
AND si.id IN
#{mainId}
ORDER BY sd.id ASC

select si.warehouse_id as warehouseId, si.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, sd.sku_id as skuId, sd.qty, si.approve_status as approveStatus, sd.delivery_status as status, si.invalid_status as invalidStatus, si.id as sourceId, si.code as sourceCode, 'soInfo' as sourceType, to_char(si.create_time, 'YYYY-MM') as date, sd.frozen_qty as frozenQty from so_info si left join so_detail sd on si.id = sd.main_id and sd.is_deleted = false
si.is_deleted = false and si.virtual_warehouse_id != ''
order by si.id desc
